promise: GBLIN Coherence Promise P2 — Honest public counters
subject: gblin.digital (GBLIN Protocol)
statement: Our public agent-economy counters are cumulative since launch and include activity generated by our own wallets. We disclose this next to the numbers, and we publish the list of our own wallets below so anyone can reproduce the split between internal and external activity from the chain.

checks.expect: status 200 AND numeric cumulative counters present

observable.kept_when: both checks pass; any silent removal of the disclosure or of this wallet list is a violation

why_it_matters: Inflated counters are the default in the agent economy (we measured a catalog where the median service has 2 calls/month while headlines claim hundreds of millions). The only honest counter is one whose composition can be reproduced by a stranger.
notes: Addresses recovered from on-chain events (USDC transfers to the fee wallet and Minted events on the GBLIN contract), lowercased as recovered. The authoritative list is maintained here and any change to it is itself observable as a hash change.
